groups.sentence: Instructors review AI-generated course materials for accuracy, appropriateness and bias, and remain responsible for them, before sharing them with students.
Instructors disclose, cite or acknowledge their use of AI in creating course materials.
Instructors tell students at the start of the course, such as in the syllabus, when course materials were created with AI.
Course statements inform students that course materials were created or assisted by AI and reviewed and verified by the instructor.
Everyone clearly discloses or labels AI use and AI-generated content in their work.
Staff disclose and label their use of AI in official documents and learning materials.
Staff are not permitted to use generative AI to produce materials.
Everyone is transparent about AI use and clearly indicates AI-generated content in documents and communications.
